aurum.nec.failure.title: [%s] Not Enough Crashes detected!
aurum.nec.failure.description:
Not Enough Crashes can severely break the game while handling crashes, and does not provide accurate results.
Good alternatives are MixinTrace and Crafty Crashes, which can identify the cause of a crash more reliably and does not put the game in an invalid state.
